name: Flying Geese
description: Flying geese patchwork: columns of triangles stacked base to tip, flying up and down by turns between plain strips of sashing.

code.style: --rule: ( background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color1) 0 8%, transparent 8% 92%, var(--color1) 92%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(180 * (@x % 2))deg) scale(1.012); transform: rotate(@calc(180 * (@x % 2))deg) scale(1.012); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10%; width: 80%; top: 0; height: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--goose); clip-path: @var(--goose); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10%; width: 80%; top: 50%; height: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--goose); clip-path: @var(--goose); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --goose: polygon(0% 100%, 50% 0%, 100% 100%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
